Since the hierarchy rewards the presence of examples when mechanisms are equally missing, response b demonstrates deeper coverage and therefore wins.

consistency_internal.explantion: Both responses exhibit the same high‑severity internal‑consistency flaws: each conflates distinct viewpoints (Blurred Viewpoints / Conflation) and presents debated claims as universally accepted (False Consensus).
